neighbours.label: ' outside' in the scope sense (outside someone's control, within or outside a jurisdiction), not physical 'outside the door'; the + pole is 'within / internal / domestic'
fire: The delay was caused by circumstances outside the airline's control.

notes: Card: ' federal', ' outside', ' international', ' own' (no single token). Probes: 'within or outside the UK' 0.40, 'outside our control' 0.39, physical 'outside the kitchen door' 0.02; ' international' 0.19-0.30, ' federal' 0.23. The label covers only the 'outside' part of the pole.
